objects.taxonomy_description: Ring-shaped bread roll with a glossy, chewy crust and dense interior crumb. The toroidal form features a central hole approximately 2-3 cm in diameter with an overall diameter of 10-12 cm. The surface exhibits a smooth, shiny glaze from boiling before baking, with golden-brown to deep amber coloration. Texture shows a firm exterior with slight blistering and a dense, chewy interior. May be topped with sesame seeds, poppy seeds, or coarse salt.

Smooth, shiny glaze from boiling before baking.

Firm exterior with slight blistering from baking.
May be topped with sesame seeds, poppy seeds, or coarse salt.

objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a spotted coat pattern, distinguishable from other large herbivores by its extreme vertical proportions.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length_Proportion: The neck is exceptionally elongated, appearing significantly longer than the torso and legs combined.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Cranial_Appendages: Two short, skin-covered bony protuberances (ossicones) are visible on the top of the head, distinct from antlers or horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coat_Pattern: The body is covered in irregular, polygonal patches of dark color separated by lighter lines, rather than stripes or solid colors.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Leg_Structure: The forelegs are noticeably longer than the hindlegs, creating a sloping back profile from shoulders to rump.

objects.taxonomy_description: Brass wind instrument with compact conical tubing coiled into oval shape. Length approximately 33 cm. Bell flares to 11-12 cm diameter, facing forward. Three piston valves arranged vertically on top with mother-of-pearl or plastic finger buttons. Mouthpiece is cup-shaped, detachable, inserted into leadpipe. Body surface is lacquered brass (golden-yellow) or silver-plated (bright white-metal). Tubing diameter gradually increases from mouthpiece to bell. Valve casings are cylindrical with visible seam lines. Bell rim is rolled edge. Finger hooks and thumb ring present for grip.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Compact conical tubing coiled into oval shape, noticeably shorter than a trumpet.
Tubing diameter gradually increases from mouthpiece to bell.
Functional_Components: Three piston valves arranged vertically on top with finger buttons.
Cup-shaped detachable mouthpiece inserted into leadpipe.
Finger hooks and thumb ring present for grip.
Material_and_Context: Valve casings are cylindrical with visible seam lines.
